name: sxw_tcpdump_analyze
description: 对新手友好的 pcap TCP 连接可视化分析器

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tcpview/core && npm run build -w @tcpview/server && npm run build -w @tcpview/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tcpview/core && concurrently -n core,server,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @tcpview/core" "npm run dev -w @tcpview/server" "npm run dev -w @tcpview/web"
